narrative.overview: Dusty rose draped satin frames an ornate ivory lace oval with a quiet opaque center. Expressive lettering carries Ashley's name and section headings. Pink, purple and white remain the confirmed palette; the supplied stationery screenshot governs this revision.
keyCharacteristics: Satin texture and transparent lace artwork.
Rose script, lavender venue and white reply surface.
Four sections with direct personal RSVP.
Photo-derived architectural watercolor with transparent painted edges in the venue section.
Landscape pink floral pattern behind the countdown, sourced from the user and rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
User-supplied pink lilies, ribbon, quill stationery, mirrored purple floral top corners and butterfly accents, extracted on transparent backgrounds.
Sticky centered Home / Details / RSVP navigation with a small active-section dot and 72px anchor clearance.
dos: Do preserve the four-section order and pink, purple and white palette.
Do keep the name centered inside the blank lace oval on all screen sizes.
Do retain artwork provenance and reduced-motion behavior.
Do identify preview replies as unsaved.
donts: Don't restore the superseded floral cutouts or gradient hero.
Don't invent event identifiers or imply production submission works.
Don't access private environment files or Supabase for verification.
